finding: This registered location-only report requires location_id in its public signature, but a direct Python call could pass None or an empty string and open a database cursor before executing its location-filtered ecological reads.
change: The generator now rejects missing location scope before opening a cursor.
limitations: All ecological report queries remain tied to the requested location; no network-level report or query behavior changed.
Tests use a mock connection; no database, provider, candidate, legacy, or external network was used.
This closes only the direct-call missing-scope path; it does not establish tenant isolation or populated-data parity.
